Priya: Morning async — quick triage check (what I did / blockers / today)
Priya: Yesterday wrapped 45 tickets, patched a flaky webhook in payments that was spamming duplicates. Filed follow-up on edge case with payment provider.
Priya: Blocker: still seeing intermittent failures on embedding jobs for a subset of customer orgs (error: "kv cache miss overflow"). I've got a repro and will escalate if it doesn't stabilize by noon.
Liam: Queue snapshot: 62 total, 7 PRs awaiting review, 6 urgent (P1/P2) — 2 infra, 4 customer-impacting.
Maya: I picked up the infra P1 (GPU pool OOMs). Root cause looks like a batch-size regression from last night's rollout. Rolling back variant now. :wrench:
Ash: Quick ask — can someone sanity-check the new macro for suspected duplicate billing? I made a small change to add `{{payment_id}}` into the template.
Priya: @Ash — I'll review in ~15. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/support-macros/pull/428 :eyes: 
OpsBot: Deploy bot: rollout complete for support-macros v1.3.2 to staging at 08:12 UTC
Liam: For the embedding failure, Priya — can you drop the failing job id(s) in #eng-ml? Might speed up root-cause. Also re: KV cache overflow — we should lower batch concurrency temporarily.
Priya: Dropped job ids in eng-ml. Temporarily set concurrency to 4 for the affected pool: `rc set inference.pool.embeddings.concurrency=4` (tested on staging).
Maya: Macro update: added guard to only run duplicate-check for invoices > $1. See snippet:
```
{"name":"duplicate_billing_check","match":"payment_id && amount > 100"}
```
Maya: Pushed a fix and opened PR: https://git.redwood/repo/support-macros/pull/429
Ash: LGTM on the macro, left one tiny comment about wording. :thumbsup:
Priya: Today's plan: monitor embedding jobs for 60m post-rollback, complete review for Ash's macro, finish 8 customer replies (escalations). If embeddings flap again, we'll fall back to cached embeddings and notify customers.
Liam: I'm OOO after 11:30 but oncall handoff with @Maya is set. Handoff doc: https://docs.redwood/support/oncall/handoffs/2026-03-17
Maya: I'll take oncall from 11:30. If any more OOMs, escalate to eng-runtime oncall and tag `@eng-runtime`.
OpsBot: Reminder: please ack the customer-facing macros PRs before EOD to keep SLA.
Priya: Thanks team — leave notes here if you pick tickets. I'll update macros PR once Ash's wording change is addressed. :party_parrot:
Liam: Picking up tickets #1032 and #1035 before I go.
Ash: I'll roll the macro wording tweak in a separate commit and ping.
Maya: Monitoring dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/queue/support?span=1h
Priya: Closing note: if anyone sees the "kv cache miss overflow" again, paste the full error and I'll attach logs. Thanks! :raised_hands:
